function validationFailure(x:unknown):boolean{return record(x)&&exact(x,["conversationId","conversationStateRevision","conversationStateHash","draftId","draftRevision","projectionHash","status","issues"])&&matches(x.conversationId,CONVERSATION)&&rev(x.conversationStateRevision)&&matches(x.conversationStateHash,SHA)&&matches(x.draftId,DRAFT)&&rev(x.draftRevision)&&matches(x.projectionHash,SHA)&&x.status==="INVALID"&&Array.isArray(x.issues)&&x.issues.length>=1&&x.issues.length<=64&&x.issues.every(issue);}
function challenge(x:unknown):boolean{return record(x)&&exact(x,["approvalChallengeId","validationReceiptId","conversationId","conversationStateRevision","conversationStateHash","draftId","draftRevision","projectionHash","semanticHash","issuedAt","expiresAt","consumptionState"])&&matches(x.approvalChallengeId,/^approval_challenge_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)&&matches(x.validationReceiptId,/^validation_receipt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)&&matches(x.conversationId,CONVERSATION)&&rev(x.conversationStateRevision)&&matches(x.conversationStateHash,SHA)&&matches(x.draftId,DRAFT)&&rev(x.draftRevision)&&matches(x.projectionHash,SHA)&&matches(x.semanticHash,SHA)&&timestamp(x.issuedAt)&&timestamp(x.expiresAt)&&new Set(["AVAILABLE","CONSUMED","INVALIDATED"]).has(String(x.consumptionState));}
function approval(x:unknown):boolean{return record(x)&&exact(x,["strategyVersionId","strategyVersionContentHash","sourceConversationId","sourceConversationStateRevision","sourceConversationStateHash","sourceDraftId","sourceDraftRevision","sourceProjectionHash","semanticHash","validationReceiptId","approvalChallengeId","issuanceReceiptId","issuedAt"])&&matches(x.strategyVersionId,/^sv_v03_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,76}$/)&&matches(x.strategyVersionContentHash,SHA)&&matches(x.sourceConversationId,CONVERSATION)&&rev(x.sourceConversationStateRevision)&&matches(x.sourceConversationStateHash,SHA)&&matches(x.sourceDraftId,DRAFT)&&rev(x.sourceDraftRevision)&&matches(x.sourceProjectionHash,SHA)&&matches(x.semanticHash,SHA)&&matches(x.validationReceiptId,/^validation_receipt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)&&matches(x.approvalChallengeId,/^approval_challenge_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)&&matches(x.issuanceReceiptId,/^issuance_receipt_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)&&timestamp(x.issuedAt);}
function meta(x:unknown):boolean{return record(x)&&exact(x,["apiContractVersion","requestId","traceId","resourceRevision"])&&x.apiContractVersion===API_V03_CONTRACT_VERSION&&matches(x.requestId,/^req_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,80}$/)&&matches(x.traceId,/^trace_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{12,80}$/)&&(x.resourceRevision===null||rev(x.resourceRevision));}
function envelope(operationId:OperationId,x:unknown):boolean{if(!record(x)||!exact(x,["meta","data"])||!meta(x.meta))return false;if(new Set<OperationId>(["createConversationV3","getConversationV3","getStrategyDraftV3","patchStrategyDraftV3"]).has(operationId))return snapshot(x.data);if(operationId==="createConversationTurnV3")return turn(x.data);if(operationId==="validateStrategyDraftV3")return receipt(x.data)||validationFailure(x.data);if(operationId==="createApprovalChallengeV3")return challenge(x.data);return approval(x.data);}
function errorEnvelope(x:unknown):x is ErrorEnvelope{return record(x)&&exact(x,["meta","error"])&&meta(x.meta)&&record(x.error)&&exact(x.error,["code","message"],["field"])&&typeof x.error.code==="string"&&ERROR_CODES.has(x.error.code as ErrorCode)&&typeof x.error.message==="string"&&x.error.message.length>=1&&x.error.message.length<=240&&(x.error.field===undefined||(matches(x.error.field,JSON_POINTER)&&x.error.field.length<=160));}
function transportResponse(x:unknown):x is TransportResponse{return record(x)&&exact(x,["status","headers","body"])&&integer(x.status,100,599)&&record(x.headers);}
function responseEtag(headers:TransportResponse["headers"]):StrongETag|null{if(!record(headers))return null;const keys=Reflect.ownKeys(headers);if(keys.some((key)=>typeof key!=="string"))return null;const names=(keys as string[]).filter((key)=>key.toLowerCase()==="etag");if(names.length!==1)return null;const descriptor=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(headers,names[0] as string);return descriptor!==undefined&&"value" in descriptor&&descriptor.enumerable&&matches(descriptor.value,ETAG)?descriptor.value:null;}
export class ApiV03ResponseError extends Error{constructor(readonly status:number,readonly code:ErrorCode|"INVALID_API_V03_RESPONSE"){super(code==="INVALID_API_V03_RESPONSE"?"INVALID_API_V03_RESPONSE":"API_V03_RESPONSE_ERROR");}}
function invalidResponse(status:number):ApiV03ResponseError{return new ApiV03ResponseError(status,"INVALID_API_V03_RESPONSE");}
function responseError(operation:ManifestOperation,status:number,body:unknown):ApiV03ResponseError|null{if(!errorEnvelope(body))return null;const expected=(operation.errorStatusByCode as Readonly<Record<ErrorCode,number>>)[body.error.code];return expected===status?new ApiV03ResponseError(status,body.error.code):null;}
function id(x:unknown,pattern:RegExp):string{if(!matches(x,pattern))throw new Error("INVALID_RESOURCE_ID");return x;}
function bodyShape(operationId:OperationId,body:unknown):void{if(!record(body))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");if(operationId==="createConversationV3"){if(!exact(body,[]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");return;}const keys=operationId==="createConversationTurnV3"?["clientMessageId","message","expectedConversationStateRevision","expectedConversationStateHash"]:operationId==="patchStrategyDraftV3"?["expectedConversationStateRevision","expectedConversationStateHash","source","draftPatch"]:operationId==="validateStrategyDraftV3"?["expectedConversationStateRevision","expectedConversationStateHash"]:operationId==="createApprovalChallengeV3"?["expectedConversationStateRevision","expectedConversationStateHash","validationReceiptId","acknowledgedSemanticHash"]:["expectedConversationStateRevision","expectedConversationStateHash","validationReceiptId","approvalChallengeId","acknowledgedSemanticHash"];if(!exact(body,keys))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");state(body as unknown as ExpectedState);if(operationId==="createConversationTurnV3"&&(!matches(body.clientMessageId,/^client_message_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,80}$/)||typeof body.message!=="string"||body.message.length<1||body.message.length>4000))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");if(operationId==="patchStrategyDraftV3"&&(!source(body.source)||!patch(body.draftPatch)))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");}
function requestFor<K extends OperationId>(operationId:K,input:OperationInputMap[K]):TransportRequest{const value=input as unknown;if(!record(value))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");let method:"GET"|"POST"|"PATCH"="GET",path:string,body:unknown=undefined,headers:Record<string,string>={};if(operationId==="createConversationV3"){if(!exact(value,["body","context"]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");method="POST";path="/api/v3/conversations";body=value.body;headers=context(value.context as MutationContext,false);}else if(operationId==="getConversationV3"){if(!exact(value,["conversationId"]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");path=`/api/v3/conversations/${id(value.conversationId,CONVERSATION)}`;}else if(operationId==="createConversationTurnV3"){if(!exact(value,["conversationId","body","context"]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");method="POST";path=`/api/v3/conversations/${id(value.conversationId,CONVERSATION)}/messages`;body=value.body;headers=context(value.context as MutationContext,true);}else if(operationId==="getStrategyDraftV3"){if(!exact(value,["draftId"]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");path=`/api/v3/strategy-drafts/${id(value.draftId,DRAFT)}`;}else{if(!exact(value,["draftId","body","context"]))throw new Error("INVALID_OPERATION_INPUT");const draft=id(value.draftId,DRAFT);method=operationId==="patchStrategyDraftV3"?"PATCH":"POST";path=`/api/v3/strategy-drafts/${draft}${operationId==="validateStrategyDraftV3"?"/validate":operationId==="createApprovalChallengeV3"?"/approval-challenges":operationId==="approveStrategyDraftV3"?"/approve":""}`;body=value.body;headers=context(value.context as MutationContext,true);}if(body!==undefined)bodyShape(operationId,body);return{method,path,headers,...(body===undefined?{}:{body}),credentials:"include"};}
export class TesiaConversationV03Client{constructor(private readonly transport:ApiV03Transport){}async callWithResponse<K extends OperationId>(operationId:K,input:OperationInputMap[K]):Promise<ApiCallResult<OperationOutputMap[K]>>{const operation=operations.get(operationId);if(operation===undefined)throw new Error("UNKNOWN_OPERATION");const raw:unknown=await this.transport.request(requestFor(operationId,input));const observedStatus=responseStatus(raw);let detached:unknown;try{detached=jsonSnapshot(raw);}catch{throw invalidResponse(observedStatus);}let response:TransportResponse;try{if(!transportResponse(detached))throw new Error("INVALID_TRANSPORT_RESPONSE");response=detached;}catch{throw invalidResponse(observedStatus);}if(response.status!==operation.successStatus){let error:ApiV03ResponseError|null;try{error=responseError(operation,response.status,response.body);}catch{throw invalidResponse(response.status);}if(error===null)throw invalidResponse(response.status);throw error;}let valid=false;try{valid=envelope(operationId,response.body);}catch{throw invalidResponse(response.status);}if(!valid)throw invalidResponse(response.status);let etag:StrongETag|null;try{etag=responseEtag(response.headers);}catch{throw invalidResponse(response.status);}if(etag===null)throw invalidResponse(response.status);return{status:response.status,headers:response.headers,etag,body:response.body as OperationOutputMap[K]};}async call<K extends OperationId>(operationId:K,input:OperationInputMap[K]):Promise<OperationOutputMap[K]>{return(await this.callWithResponse(operationId,input)).body;}}
